title: Verify incomplete coverage metadata in OpenAQ sensor responses
problem: API #404 reports a location sensor-list HTTP 500 when reporting-period metadata is missing. The pinned original SQL functions produce the five reported null fields, which fail the original API response model. This synthetic contract reproduction does not establish deployed frequency or the intended database/API fix.
humanitarian_relevance: OpenAQ supports community access to pollution measurements. Preventing a sensor metadata failure from interrupting data access could aid analysis; no affected humanitarian user, health outcome or realized benefit is established.

evidence.claim: The issue reports a location sensor-list error; a diagnostic comment attributes five response-validation errors to missing logging/averaging values and proposes requiring those values in the database.

At the pinned source revision, Sensor.coverage permits null but Coverage requires non-null numeric/string fields. The original sensor route calls calculate_coverage with reporting periods when a latest value exists. This is static source evidence, not a reproduced server error.

Eight original-model/synthetic FastAPI scenarios passed expected assertions, including HTTP 500 for incomplete coverage and mixed valid/invalid sensors. Seven outputs from two unchanged SQL coverage functions were checked against the original model; two zero-period controls returned SQLSTATE 22012. The original router and deployed schema were not exercised.

All 24 original sensor-route scenarios met assertions using the original query builder, response models and unedited DB.fetchPage with synthetic DB.fetch rows. Both endpoints reject incomplete coverage; valid and absent coverage pass. Database init.sql includes tables/metadata.sql, where both period columns are nullable integers without defaults in their definitions. Deployed constraints and ingestion remain unverified.

code_surface: API 87c060c28f5b484e0e9953d247082f5e678935c9: Coverage/Sensor/SensorsResponse, original sensor routes, QueryBuilder and DB.fetchPage. Database 0e49c258186372f4af6c5679a4e1ab47157f0158: calculate_coverage in idempotent/util_functions.sql; init.sql includes tables/metadata.sql, which adds both period columns as nullable integers.
proposed_change: First verify the failure and intended coverage contract. If accepted, provide a focused regression and agreed handling for missing reporting metadata; do not silently invent intervals, zero coverage, or widen response nullability.
research_next_step: Check current ingestion ownership and complete contributor/AI-policy review, then prepare a concise scope inquiry grounded in the original-route reproduction and nullable column definitions. Maintainers must choose API handling versus ingestion/database invariants. Pure models, calculation functions and routes with synthetic database rows are already tested.
priority_rationale: Air-pollution burden and named OpenAQ community use motivate this research path. Select the unassigned sensor-access report over future SDK cleanup and already-owned Explorer/API fixes. No implementation priority or realized impact is implied.
tests: Prior eight model/HTTP scenarios and nine SQL checks passed. Now 24 original-router scenarios pass: ten row conditions on each endpoint plus four invalid-ID controls. Original QueryBuilder and unedited DB.fetchPage execute with synthetic DB.fetch rows; expected validation exceptions and HTTP effects checked separately. All 22 fetched API and 21 database files remain unchanged. Full SQL joins, middleware, upstream suite and deployed data remain untested.
environment: Isolated Python 3.13.7 environment installed 17 lockfile-hashed wheels without source builds. Original response models use Pydantic 2.11.1 and FastAPI 0.115.12. SQL ran in a fresh temporary PostgreSQL 14.18 cluster in single-user mode. Both probes ran with OS network denial; no listening service, existing database, cloud deployment or operational data request. Full application/test setup remains unresolved. The original router and query builder now run with original response wrapping and synthetic DB.fetch rows; no additional packages or connection settings needed.
maintainer: Issue #404 is open and unassigned with one diagnostic comment; its inspected timeline has no linked PR. No Humanifest outreach, confirmed scope, reviewer commitment or follow-up date.
risks: Checked-in initialization adds nullable period columns in tables/metadata.sql; the earlier missing source location is resolved. This does not prove deployed constraints or current ingestion behavior. Actual prevalence, affected users, full regression environment, AI/bot eligibility and complete contribution policy remain unresolved.
